title: 5.2 Introduction to the World Wide Web
description: The world wide web concepts and details. Medium level, 20 questions.
tags: introduction to the world wide web

questions.question: Which statement distinguishes the Internet from the Web?
options: The Web is an information service built on the Internet
The Internet is a collection of linked web pages worldwide
The Web is the physical network of computers
They are two different names for the same global system
questions.correctAnswer: The Web is an information service built on the Internet

questions.question: What does a web server do?
options: It stores and delivers pages on request
It requests pages from a browser on a client
It renders HTML for the user
questions.correctAnswer: It stores and delivers pages on request

questions.question: What happens first after a user enters a URL?
options: The browser performs a DNS lookup
The browser renders the page immediately
The server sends a requested file
The router changes the IP address
questions.correctAnswer: The browser performs a DNS lookup

questions.question: What happens after the DNS lookup?
options: The browser sends an HTTP request
The browser closes the current connection
The server performs a DNS lookup
questions.correctAnswer: The browser sends an HTTP request

questions.question: What does the browser do with HTML and CSS?
options: It renders the page for the user
It stores the page on a remote server
It sends email to the server
questions.correctAnswer: It renders the page for the user

questions.question: Which language executes in the browser for interactivity?
What is the default TCP port for HTTP?
Which request methods does HTTP use?
How is HTTP data transmitted by default?
What issues HTTPS certificates?
What indicates a secure HTTPS connection in a browser?
options: An "https://" prefix and a neutral icon
A plain "http://" prefix in the browser address
A red warning icon in the address bar
A missing protocol label in the address
questions.correctAnswer: An "https://" prefix and a neutral icon

questions.question: What kind of naming system is DNS?
options: Flat and controlled by one server

questions.question: What does a DNS resolver query first?
Which server provides the address of a domain’s name server?
Which server returns the final IP address?
In a URL, what appears before the first dot?
What are URL parameters?
options: Key-value pairs after a question mark
The path to a specific web page on the site
The domain extension of the site
questions.correctAnswer: Key-value pairs after a question mark

questions.question: Which character separates URL parameters?
In a URL, what is "/shoes/"?
What is a URL slug?
options: The part identifying a specific page
A network cable standard for servers
questions.correctAnswer: The part identifying a specific page
